goals.objective: Migrate /home/avell/Projects/unchain0/flashcards-generator to a production-quality Textual TUI on Python 3.10. The commands 'flashcards' and 'python -m flashcards_generator' launch the TUI; secondary 'flashcards-cli' preserves non-interactive generate/merge/cleanup. Reuse existing domain/application/infrastructure/adapters and current AnkiConnect, CSV, NotebookLM behavior; do not duplicate business logic in screens/widgets. Deliver responsive Generate input/file discovery and in-terminal PDF/PPTX picker, settings/advanced options, real background generation with progress events, safe cancellation and subprocess cleanup, Results with CSV/cards/merge/open/copy/new-run actions, Merge, NotebookLM auth/language/cleanup with explicit all confirmation, XDG-persistent Settings, integrated logs, keyboard footer/help, and Linux terminal UX. Extract UI-independent composition, progress, and cancellation contracts where needed; preserve resumable chunk state and partial failure behavior; keep imports one-way and the existing CLI tested. Tier HEAVY: primary-interface migration, runtime UI framework, composition boundaries, concurrency/cancellation, persistent settings, and broad user-facing behavior. C001 shell/entrypoints: exact commands 'uv run flashcards --help' and 'uv run python -m flashcards_generator --help' must start the TUI under a real PTY or expose its Textual app test surface without traceback; 'uv run flashcards-cli generate --help', merge, and cleanup remain available. C002 Generate/progress: Textual Pilot with fake NotebookLM selects PDF/PPTX, builds real GenerateFlashcardsRequest, starts exactly one worker, receives progress/result state, and cancellation leaves no worker/process; capture RED before and GREEN after. C003 Results/Merge: Pilot executes real CsvMerger/MergeCsvRequest and shows valid output/counts, while completed generation exposes CSV paths/cards; no business logic is reimplemented in UI. C004 NotebookLM/Settings/Picker: Pilot covers auth state, login delegation, cleanup-all confirmation, XDG load/save/invalid fallback, and keyboard directory navigation including Unicode/spaces/empty folders. C005 usability/manual surface: real xterm.js-rendered TUI screenshots/transcript at wide and narrow terminal sizes prove visible tabs/footer/shortcuts, no overflow, and no log dumping; exercise happy, invalid, and cancel actions. C006 regression/quality: full existing suite plus TUI tests, ruff/format, mypy, build, and project quality gates exit zero. Every behavioral criterion needs failing-first Textual Pilot/integration or real PTY evidence; documentation gets review/read QA. Stop only when all criteria are RED-to-GREEN, manual artifacts and cleanup receipts exist, final quality is green, independent audit is complete, and ulw-loop marks this objective complete.

successCriteria.scenario: Shell and entrypoints: run `uv run flashcards` in a real PTY and `uv run python -m flashcards_generator` in a Textual Pilot/PTY; PASS iff both open the same Textual app with Header, tab navigation and Footer without traceback, while `uv run flashcards-cli generate --help`, `uv run flashcards-cli merge --help`, and `uv run flashcards-cli cleanup --help` remain non-interactive argparse surfaces with exit 0. Exercise q/g/r/m/n/s/?/Escape through the app and PASS iff the active screen changes or help/modal closes as specified.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/C001-shell-wide.txt + C001-shell-narrow.txt + C001-entrypoints.txt: PTY action logs/screenshots/transcripts for both primary entrypoints and secondary CLI help, including visible IDs/tabs/footer and zero traceback. Failing-first: `tests/tui/test_app.py::test_primary_shell_mounts_and_navigates` and `tests/integration/test_entrypoints.py::test_flashcards_dispatches_tui` must be RED before implementation and GREEN after.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/C001-red-entrypoints.txt: before implementation, the real module entrypoint returned old CLI help/exit 1 and the flashcards-cli script was missing under the exact integration test command.
successCriteria.notes: RED captured before Textual shell/entrypoint production changes; failure is the intended old-interface contract.

successCriteria.scenario: Generate, Progress, Results and Merge: in Textual Pilot run `uv run pytest tests/tui/test_generate.py tests/tui/test_progress.py tests/tui/test_results_merge.py -vv`; fake the NotebookLM/application facade, select Unicode PDF/PPTX paths, assert a real GenerateFlashcardsRequest, exactly one exclusive thread worker, ordered progress/result state, safe cancellation with no live worker/process, Results CSV/card/count actions, and a real CsvMerger/MergeCsvRequest merge with before/after duplicate counts. PASS iff Pilot completes these states without event-loop blocking and the existing CSV/Anki output contracts remain valid.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/C002-pilot-generate-results-merge.txt + C002-cancel-cleanup.txt: Textual Pilot logs, typed requests/outcomes, generated CSV, merge output/counts and process/worker cleanup. Failing-first: each named Pilot test is RED before its corresponding production seam and GREEN afterward; mutation proof must show default CSV and cancellation assertions fail when the guard is removed.

successCriteria.scenario: NotebookLM, Settings and Picker plus regression/quality: in Textual Pilot run `uv run pytest tests/tui/test_notebook_settings_picker.py tests/tui/test_settings.py tests/tui/test_path_picker.py -vv`; PASS iff auth status/login/language delegate through injected services, cleanup-all requires an explicit in-TUI confirmation and reports deleted/failed counts, XDG settings round-trip Unicode and invalid JSON falls back without overwriting, and the picker navigates Home/../current directories, filters PDF/PPTX, selects empty folders, and preserves paths with spaces. Also run the existing CLI regression commands and final quality gates.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/C003-notebook-settings-picker.txt + C003-cli-regression.txt + C003-quality.txt: Pilot state/action logs, XDG files, cleanup confirmation result, Unicode picker selection, CLI exit statuses and final suite/lint/type/build results. Failing-first: named Pilot/settings/picker tests are RED before implementation and GREEN after; documentation is reviewed/read-QA only.
